hebrewText: תִּמְכֹּֽר עַמְּ/ךָ֥ בְ/לֹא ה֑וֹן וְ/לֹ֥א רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּ/מְחִירֵי/הֶֽם

tokens.bdb: to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender)
a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais
